Dear ViennaR members,

The next meetup will take place
on:
  Tuesday, February 25, 2020  6:30 PM to 8:30 PM

  How to find us: 13th Floor, Hall 1


We start the new decade with a hot topic in our community: R in production.
Our speakers are Thomas Strehl, Rudolf Pailer, Thomas Weinrich and
Mario Annau showing different ways of deploying R models into
production.
The Meetup ist hosted at IBM Austria (Obere DonaustraÃŸe 95) and cool
drinks are secured for a lively discussion and networking session
afterwards :)

TOPICS

1. Thomas Strehl, Rudolf Pailer, Thomas Weinrich: Aspects of bringing
R based machine learning to the enterprise

2. Mario Annau: Deployment of machine learning models using RStudio
Connect and the cloud.

DETAILS

1. The enterprise requires Machine Learning to advance from it's
'magic blackbox' nimbus into a well understood and governed asset that
evolves from and interacts with enterprise processes. In particular
the core assets of machine learning, that is the data, the model
creation and verification process, the scoring engine and all
interactions with other enterprise applications, need to be subjected
to strict version and quality control to ensure traceability and
compliance compatibility.

2. Case study showing the creation and deployment of a machine
learning model as REST-API and Shiny-app into production using RStudio
connect. Alternatively, showing fast API cloud deployments using
Qbits: https://www.quantargo.com/qbits

See you there!

Greetings,
ViennaR organizers
